sources.name: Hymnary.org
sources.what_we_take: Public-domain English hymn texts, author death years, meters, and evidence URLs for PD status. Established Spanish hymn texts when the page marks them public domain.
sources.what_we_refuse: Copyrighted modern texts, user-uploaded copyrighted scans treated as the New BHB compilation, full hymnal dumps.
sources.license: Individual hymn texts that are public domain; site terms govern scraping. We store only verified PD texts.

sources.name: Brethren Archive historic Believers Hymn Book scan
sources.what_we_take: Metadata confirmation that a first line appeared in classic BHB editions (1884-era / mid-20th-c. reprints). Classic book numbers when visible.
sources.what_we_refuse: Treating the scan as a training dump of the modern New Believers Hymn Book (2019) compilation or numbering system.
sources.license: Historic book scans; individual hymn texts remain PD by author death year. Compilation arrangement is not our training target.

sources.name: pdhymns.com / hymnstogod.org
sources.what_we_take: Public-domain English hymn texts for confirmation against Hymnary.
sources.what_we_refuse: Any text marked restricted or modern copyright.

sources.name: Historic Spanish Protestant hymnals (e.g. Cabrera and pre-1929 himnarios)
sources.what_we_take: Established Spanish translations of the same English original when the Spanish text is PD (translator died ≥70 years ago or published pre-1929).
sources.what_we_refuse: Metrical paraphrases presented as literal caption Spanish; modern copyrighted Spanish hymnals without clear reuse rights.
sources.license: Public domain Spanish hymn texts (e.g. Juan Bautista Cabrera, d. 1916).

sources.name: Historic Lutheran / Protestant bilingual hymn lists
sources.what_we_take: Same-original EN–ES pairs that are independently PD.
sources.what_we_refuse: Thematic-only pairs (same tune, different words) for training.

refused.name: New Believers Hymn Book (2019) / John Ritchie Ltd compilation
refused.why: Compilation copyright, numbering, and 2019-only added hymns are not free for wholesale training dumps. We may use classic first lines that also exist as independent PD texts.

refused.name: BHB+ app database / Gospel Folio music edition
refused.why: Proprietary database and music edition; not a PD text source.

refused.name: Wholesale scrape of gospelriver.com as 'the book'
refused.why: Lookup of first lines for identification is fine; training text must be attributed to the PD hymn text, not 'New BHB #N'.

refused.name: Himnos y Cánticos del Evangelio full official dump
refused.why: Requires LEC permission for full lyrics. First-line mappings only as metadata if from public indexes; no full lyrics in this corpus.

refused.name: JW.org hymn / song texts
refused.why: Out of domain and copyrighted; forbidden.

refused.name: CCLI-only modern worship
refused.why: Copyrighted contemporary songs; not PD hymn texts.

notes: Training uses public-domain hymn *texts* only. The Believers Hymn Book / New BHB is a copyrighted compilation; classic first lines are identifiers, not a license to dump the book.
